title: Fact offer
description: Fact offer (FactOffer) to a successor when an identity retires or its binding changes (MEM-7). Only the core writes it. It contains only active facts, rechecked at creation, at most memory.offer.max (100), only in the same tenant and only to one successor: the new identity of the same worker, else the first identity enrolled in the same role, for a seat holder the next holder of the seat. It is open until the end of the seal of the leaving identity (open_until). Code copies the facts that pass a recheck; neither a person nor a model chooses them. P2 and the summary show only numbers.

tenant.description: Tenant of the offer and the recipient; the farm manager has a separate offer for the section of each tenant.

from_bot.description: The leaving identity or the identity that changed its binding.

bot.description: Successor, or null while there is none.

copied.description: Ids of the facts copied to the successor with the mark inherited, within the free room of its space.

recipient.description: Recipient within the offer: one, the successor under MEM-7.

open_until.description: End of the seal of the leaving identity.
